                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        বিক্রম সারির বাম প্রান্ত থেকে 11তম স্থানে আছে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        অদিত্য ডানপ্রান্ত থেকে 3য় স্থানে আছে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        বিক্রম এবং অদিত্যের মাঝে 14 জন লোক দাঁড়িয়ে আছে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        সুতরাং, মোট ব্যক্তি = 11 + 3 + 14 = 28

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        সুতরাং, মোট 28 জন লোক ওই সারিতে দাঁড়িয়ে আছে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        অতএব, সঠিক উত্তর হল \"বিকল্প 1\".

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "ml": "", "gu": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        આપેલ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        વિક્રમ હરોળના ડાબા છેડેથી 11મા સ્થાને ઉભો છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        આદિત્ય જમણા છેડેથી 3જા સ્થાને ઉભો છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        વિક્રમ અને આદિત્યની વચ્ચે 14 લોકો ઉભા છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        તો, તે હરોળમાં કુલ '28' લોકો ઉભા છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "kn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ವಿಕ್ರಮ್ ಎಡಭಾಗದಿಂದ 11ನೇ ಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾನೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಆದಿತ್ಯ ಬಲಭಾಗದಿಂದ 3ನೇ ಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾನೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಹೀಗಾಗಿ, ಆ ಸಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಟ್ಟು '28' ಜನರಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ஆகவே, அந்த வரிசையில் மொத்தம் '28' பேர் நிற்கிறார்கள்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The logic followed here is:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Logic: (1st number)3rd number = 2nd number.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Now,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For, (17, 4913, 3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (17)3 = 4913.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For, (9, 6561, 4)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (9)4 = 6561.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Similarly, for Option 4: (7, 49, 2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (7)2 = 49.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        यहाँ अनुसरित तर्क निम्नानुसार है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        तर्क: (पहली संख्या)तीसरी संख्या = दूसरी संख्या

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        अब,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (17, 4913, 3) के लिए,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (17)3 = 4913

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (9, 6561, 4) के लिए,&l", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఇక్కడ అనుసరించిన తర్కం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        తర్కం: (1వ సంఖ్య) 3వ సంఖ్య = 2వ సంఖ్య .

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఇప్పుడు,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (17, 4913, 3) కోసం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (17) 3 = 4913.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (9, 6561, 4) కోసం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (9) 4 = 6561.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        అదేవిధంగా, ఎంపిక 4 కోసం: (7, 49, 2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (7) 2 = 49.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        కాబట్టి, సరైన సమాధానం \"ఎంపిక 4\" .

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n296:T6db,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        येथे अनुसरण केलेला तर्क असा आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        तर्क: येथे अनुसरण केलेला तर्क असा आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        तर्क: (पहिली संख्या)तिसरी संख्या = दुसरी संख्या.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        आता,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (17, 4913, 3) साठी, 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (17)3 = 4913.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (9, 6561, 4) साठी, 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (9)4 = 6561.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        त्याचप्रमाणे, पर्याय 4 साठी: (7, 49, 2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (7)2 = 49.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        म्हणून, योग्य उत्तर \"पर्याय 4\" आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n297:T790,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        এখানে অনুসৃত যুক্তি হল:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        লজিক: (1ম সংখ্যা)এখানে অনুসৃত যুক্তি হল:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        লজিক: (1ম সংখ্যা)3য় সংখ্যা = 2য় সংখ্যা.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        এখন,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (17, 4913, 3) এর জন্য

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (17)3 = 4913

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (9, 6561, 4) এর জন্য

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ અહીં અનુસરવામાં આવેલો તર્ક છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        તર્ક: (પહેલો નંબર)ત્રીજો નંબર = બીજો નંબર.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        હવે,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        માટે, (17, 4913, 3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (17)3 = 4913.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಸರಿಸಲಾದ ತರ್ಕವೆಂದರೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ತರ್ಕ: (ಮೊದಲ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ)ಮೂರನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = ಎರಡನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಈಗ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (17, 4913, 3) ಗಾಗಿ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (17)3 = 4913.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        இங்குப் பின்பற்றப்படும் தர்க்கம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        தர்க்கம்: (1வது எண்)3வது எண் = 2வது எண்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        இப்போது,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (17, 4913, 3) என்பதற்கு

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (17)3 = 4913.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (9, 6561, 4) என்பதற்கு

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (9)4 = 6561.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        அதேபோல், விருப்பம் 4: (7, 49, 2) என்பதற்கு

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The North Eastern Regional Language Centre (NERLC) is located in Guwahati.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The North Eastern Regional Language Centre (NERLC) is one of the regional language centers under the Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • It plays a significant role in promoting linguistic diversity, preserving endangered languages, and fostering multilingual education in the northeastern states of India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • It Operates under the Ministry of Education, Government of India
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The main functions of the Regional Language Centres include the following:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • To offer intensive courses in various Indian languages (other than their mother tongue) for in-service secondary school teachers (deputed by different state governments) through modern methods, including instruction in the language laboratory in three levels, viz., basic, intermediate and advanced courses (special emphasis is given to speaking and comprehension in the first stage and speaking, reading and writing at the subsequent stages).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • To train these teachers in the methodology of teaching the second language by giving them linguistic orientation; to enable them to prepare teaching material and use it in their institution after the completion of the course.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • To prepare suitable instructional materials for the learning and teaching of Indian languages as a second language at different levels for different cross sections of the society.
