                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - S = 48 - 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ = 24 ವರ್ಷಗಳು

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "ta": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          16 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன்பு, தந்தையின் வயது = 4 x மகனின் வயது

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          இப்போது, தந்தையின் வயது = 2 x மகனின் வயது

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          கணக்கீடு:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          F = தந்தையின் தற்போதைய வயது, S = மகனின் தற்போதைய வயது எனக்கொள்க.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - 16 = 4(S - 16)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F = 2S

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - 16 = 4S - 64 ⇒ F = 4S - 48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          F = 2S என்பதைச் சமன்பாடு 1 இல் பிரதியிடவும்: ⇒ 2S = 4S - 48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 2S - 4S = -48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ -2S = -48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ S = 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          இப்போது, F ஐக் கண்டறியவும்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F = 2 x 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F = 48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          அவர்களது வயதுகளுக்கு இடையிலான வித்தியாசம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - S = 48 - 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ வித்தியாசம் = 24 ஆண்டுகள்

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "or": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଦିଆଯାଇଛି:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          16 ବର୍ଷ ପୂର୍ବେ, ପିତାଙ୍କ ବୟସ = ପୁଅର ବୟସର 4 ଗୁଣ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ, ପିତାଙ୍କ ବୟସ = ପୁଅର ବୟସର 2 ଗୁଣ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଧରନ୍ତୁ F = ପିତାଙ୍କର ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ବୟସ, S = ପୁଅର ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ବୟସ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - 16 = 4(S - 16)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F = 2S

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - 16 = 4S - 64 ⇒ F = 4S - 48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ସମୀକରଣ 1 ରୁ F = 2S କୁ ସ୍ଥାନିତ କରନ୍ତୁ: ⇒ 2S = 4S - 48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 2S - 4S = -48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ -2S = -48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ S = 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ, F ଖୋଜ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F = 2 x 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F = 48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ସେମାନଙ୍କ ବୟସ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପାର୍ଥକ୍ୟ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - S = 48 - 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ ପାର୍ଥକ୍ୟ = 24 ବର୍ଷ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          16 ਸਾਲ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ, ਪਿਤਾ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ = 4 x ਪੁੱਤਰ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਹੁਣ, ਪਿਤਾ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ = 2 x ਪੁੱਤਰ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਮੰਨ ਲਓ F = ਪਿਤਾ ਦੀ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਉਮਰ, S = ਪੁੱਤਰ ਦੀ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਉਮਰ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - 16 = 4(S - 16)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F = 2S

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - 16 = 4S - 64 ⇒ F = 4S - 48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          F = 2S ਨੂੰ ਸਮੀਕਰਨ 1 ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲੋ: ⇒ 2S = 4S - 48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 2S - 4S = -48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ -2S = -48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ S = 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਹੁਣ, F ਲੱਭੋ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F = 2 x 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F = 48

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਉਮਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅੰਤਰ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ F - S = 48 - 24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ ਅੰਤਰ = 24 ਸਾਲ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is 8 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given: \\(u=-45cm\\), \\(f=30cm\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Using the lens formula, \\(\\frac{1}{f}=\\frac{1}{v}-\\frac{1}{u}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow \\frac{1}{30}=\\frac{1}{v}-\\frac{1}{-45}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow \\frac{1}{v}=\\frac{1}{30}-\\frac{1}{45}=\\frac{3-2}{90}=\\frac{1}{90}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Thus, \\(v=90cm\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Using magnification formula, \\(m=\\frac{v}{u}=\\frac{90}{-45}=-2\\) (negative sign indicates, image will be inverted).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Diameter of image = m * Diameter of the object = \\(-2\\times4cm=8cm\\).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Convex Lens:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A convex lens is a converging lens that converges light rays passing through it to a point.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • It has a positive focal length.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Convex lenses are used in various optical instruments like cameras, magnifying glasses, and eyeglasses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Lens Formula:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The lens formula is given by: \\(\\frac{1}{f}=\\frac{1}{v}-\\frac{1}{u}\\) where \\(f\\) is the focal length of the lens, \\(v\\) is the image distance from the lens, and \\(u\\) is the object distance from the lens.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The distances are measured from the optical center of the lens, with the convention that distances measured in the direction of the incident light are positive, and those against the direction are negative.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Magnification:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Magnification (\\(m\\)) is given by the ratio of the height of the image (\\(h_i\\)hi ) to the height of the object (\\(h_o\\)) and can also be expressed as the ratio of the image distance (\\(v\\)) to the object distance (\\(u\\)): \\(m=\\frac{h_i}{h_o}=\\frac{v}{u}\\)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • In this case, the diameter of the coin is used instead of height, as both are proportional.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          सही उत्तर 8 सेमी है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है: \\(u=-45cm\\), \\(f=30cm\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          लेंस सूत्र का उपयोग करते हुए, \\(\\frac{1}{f}=\\frac{1}{v}-\\frac{1}{u}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow \\frac{1}{30}=\\frac{1}{v}-\\frac{1}{-45}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow \\frac{1}{v}=\\frac{1}{30}-\\frac{1}{45}=\\frac{3-2}{90}=\\frac{1}{90}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
