                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ 2 x 32 + 4 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ 64 + 4 = 68

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ਇਸ ਲਈ, ਸਹੀ ਵਿਕਲਪ \"ਵਿਕਲਪ 3\" ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\ne:[\"$\",\"$L2d\",null,{\"testData\":{\"title\":\"RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 3)\",\"sections\":[{\"_id\":\"628542a7f87f5ae63c941aa8\",\"qCount\":100,\"title\":\"CBT\",\"time\":0,\"questions\":[{\"isNum\":false,\"type\":\"mcq\",\"negMarks\":0.33,\"posMarks\":1,\"skipMarks\":0,", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Puzzle"], "concept": "Puzzle", "confidence": "high"}]}]}
